About the role
Frontier AI labs are building coding agents that do real engineering work. Before these coding agents ship, Senior Engineers have to work a real problem from a codebase they know, step by step, to identify where a frontier model goes wrong then correct it.
Not just anyone can do this. It takes a select group of engineers with experience and taste.
Engineers who qualify join a fixed-pay contract: earn $4,800/wk for 40hrs of work ($120/hr). Work on your own schedule, paid weekly.
What you'll do
Judge the AI's work.
Give an agent a real ticket, then review its output like a teammate's pull request: run it, evaluate it.
Pair with the AI on your own task.
Work a real problem from a codebase you know, step by step, and flag where the model goes wrong.
What's in it for you
Senior-engineer pay.
A weekly contract paying $4,800 for a 40-hour week. Work from anywhere, any time.
Work that lasts.
This is not a two-week gig. The work is here month after month, and the 40 hours are yours every week you're on the team.
An elite, hand-picked team.
You’ll have priority access to the projects frontier labs trust us with, the ones every engineer wants a seat on.
Problems that are actually hard.
Your work on difficult tasks goes straight back to the labs training the next best-in-class models.
A seat at the table.
You'll work directly with project leads from day one. Your read on where models fail and where the bar should sit shapes how we run these programs.
Ongoing, on your schedule.
The contract renews every week while you meet quality standards. You set your hours. Exceptional engineers may be approved for additional hours, paid at $120/hr on top of your base earnings.
Support that meets your needs.
A dedicated team, fast answers, and real feedback on your work.
How it works
Pass a proctored coding assessment, without the use of AI tools. You’ll earn $100 when you pass. About 2 hours.
Complete one paid trial task. You’ll earn $40 when you submit your first stage and $880 once it's approved through every review cycle. About 10 hours total.
Join the team and continue working. We’ll provide 40 hours of work every week, totalling $4,800.
You're a fit if you have
4+ years of professional software engineering experience
A Bachelor's or Master’s degree in computer science or a related field
Canada work authorization
Strong written English and 40 hours a week to give during your contract
No AI background needed. Your software engineering skills are the whole job.

Provide clear, structured written feedback to help improve AI model performance
Work remotely and complete tasks at your own pace, with no set schedule or minimum hour requirement

Credential: Currently holds the Registered Vascular Technologist (RVT) credential from ARDMS, or the equivalent Registered Vascular Specialist (RVS) credential from Cardiovascular Credentialing International (CCI)
Clinical depth: Working knowledge in one or more of the following areas:
Lower and upper extremity arterial duplex and physiologic testing
Venous duplex, including DVT evaluation and venous insufficiency mapping
Carotid and cerebrovascular duplex, including transcranial Doppler
Abdominal vascular studies, including renal, mesenteric, and aortic imaging
Dialysis access and vein mapping
Post-intervention surveillance, including stents, grafts, and endovascular aneurysm repair (EVAR)
Waveform analysis and hemodynamic assessment
Additional qualifications
(not required, but strengthen your application)
Additional credentials, such as RDMS or RDCS, or experience across multiple vascular and ultrasound specialties
Experience in an accredited vascular lab (e.g., IAC-accredited), academic medical center, or vascular surgery practice, experience training students or new technologists, or familiarity with reporting and image management systems
Required for all applicants
Must have US work authorization
Strong written communication and attention to detail
Ability to explain complex vascular testing concepts clearly
Ability to work independently in a remote, asynchronous environment
